messages:
Asha (Treasury): Quick broadcast: starting July 1 were piloting an early-pay discount program for strategic SaaS vendors. Purpose: capture small cash discounts while keeping AP cadence predictable. Details + signup form on Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/finance/early-pay-pilot :memo:

Diego (Procurement): TL;DR: vendors can opt into 2%/15 net-30 or 1%/30 net-60. Finance will only approve for vendors meeting credit & compliance checks. If approved, Procurement will add 'EPD' tag to the vendor record.

Renee (Vendor Ops): Important operational bits:
- Vendors must be on our Bill.com flow and accept ACH or card.
- Enrollment requires current W-9/W-8 and an executed vendor addendum.
- Pilot limited to 50 vendors; priority to high-frequency billed vendors and those with existing rebates.

Liam (FP&A): A few notes for forecasting: early-pay discounts reduce gross spend but also reduce days payable outstanding. Well surface opt-ins in the weekly cash forecast and adjust runway math accordingly. Tag FP&A in the ticket when you request vendor opt-in.

procurement-bot: Enrollment checklist: vendor_tax_form, payment_terms_choice (2%/15 or 1%/30), bank_details_on_file, compliance_status=clear. Missing items -> auto-return. (Ref: EPD-PILOT-2026) :white_check_mark:

Diego (Procurement): If a team wants a vendor prioritized for the pilot, open a procurement ticket with business case (annual spend, billing cadence) and tag @Asha + @Liam. Well review weekly on Fridays.

Asha (Treasury): Risk note: Treasury can pause early-pay offers for any vendor if fraud or abnormal activity is detected. Well also limit card payouts for pilot vendors until ACH is validated.

Renee (Vendor Ops): Also: vendors enrolled in early-pay cannot simultaneously enroll in extended net terms promotions. Pick one program per vendor.

Liam (FP&A): Action items: teams with vendors invoicing monthly and >$3k/mo that want to participate  please nominate by June 18. Procurement will contact vendors and collect docs.

Diego (Procurement): Any questions or edge-cases, reply here or open ticket subject: "EPD-NOMINATION".

Asha (Treasury): Thanks team. Well publish a short FAQ and run a 30-min info session next Tues. Reply here if you want the invite. :calendar:
